title: courier.email.delivered payload
description: The `data` payload of the `courier.email.delivered` event: a provider accepted the message. This is the only one of courier's five types it emits today. The envelope is validated by schemas/event-envelope.schema.json; this schema validates what is inside `data`. The file path is the event type with dots as directory separators. See docs/event-naming.md.

message_id.description: The notification. Always equal to the envelope's `subject`. Also written into the RFC 5322 `Message-ID` header of the sent mail as `<message_id@cafaye.com>`, which is how a later bounce that quotes it can be tied back to this row.

user_id.description: The user the message was for. A uuid from identity, not a cafaye-prefixed id: see D7.

notification_type.description: Which of courier's three messages this was.

email.description: The address the message went to, taken from the built message rather than from the caller's payload.
